name: @sugarcommerce/flyouts
description: The panels' scripts -- opening and closing, loading and saving, the header menu, prompts and alerts, and the components' own -- built to assets/build with @wordpress/scripts.

scripts.build: wp-scripts build wp-flyout=./src/js/wp-flyout.js accordion=./src/js/accordion.js action-buttons=./src/js/action-buttons.js activity=./src/js/activity.js image-picker=./src/js/image-picker.js line-items=./src/js/line-items.js refund-form=./src/js/refund-form.js --output-path=assets/build
scripts.start: wp-scripts start wp-flyout=./src/js/wp-flyout.js accordion=./src/js/accordion.js action-buttons=./src/js/action-buttons.js activity=./src/js/activity.js image-picker=./src/js/image-picker.js line-items=./src/js/line-items.js refund-form=./src/js/refund-form.js --output-path=assets/build
